proxy-master-stock-recipient.head: fa73c302
proxy-master-stock-recipient.scope: Stock 1107 used the visible selected owned Proxy. The two-second cast spent 190 IS and started 15-second own reuse. The same pet changed from 2.00 to 3.00 IS/s and cost 10.00 to 7.50. Archive unload removed the action and parent bonus while the already landed effect persisted. Deactivate and resummon produced a new pet ID with baseline cost 10.00. PR1051 also observed immediate and 10 s condition sweeps and about 0.5% max HP/s on the owned pet while the friendly control stayed flat.

choreography.source: The retained 140-unit Pistol Whip win links 501 to ILDB move 287. The ordinary resolver keeps the opposing tactic exchange when the queued Whip loses.
choreography.runtime: A winning queued 501 uses its named presentation. On an ordinary lost exchange the opponent uses the ordinary round animation, no 501 hit or state lands, and interlock continues.
choreography.test: PR995 stock performed the winning 287 and landed Blind. PR1002 stock, with one disposable roll aid, observed ordinary opponent win 0x1 and animation 20496, no 287 or 501 hit/Blind, and continued interlock. The fixture changes the hit comparison only. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/995#issuecomment-7105522085 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1002#issuecomment-7108073444

501.note: Historical landed damage and Blind duration remain open.

stats.source: The 1107 GOB authors pet cost reduction 25%, IS and HP regen +50%, and the 10% sweep marker for 600 s.
stats.runtime: CoderPets applies the percentages to the selected pet’s action cost and elapsed resource clock. The HP bonus uses the common maximum-HP rate.
stats.test: ProxyMasterUsesThePetBudgetAndSettlesExactExpiry and ProxyMasterHealthBonusUsesElapsedTimeAndStopsAtTheSameExpiry check resource clocks and exact expiry. Stock PR1051 measures cost 10→7.5, IS 2→3/s, HP +0.5% max/s and an unchanged max. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1051#issuecomment-7120753093

script.source: NegativeConditionSweepPulse calls for an initial sweep and a ten-second interval with authored 10% chance.
script.runtime: The pet effects ledger applies the shared sweep to the selected owned recipient. Cleanup is tied to that pet.
script.test: ProxyMasterSweepsOnlyTheRecipientOnInitAndEveryTenSeconds verifies the interval and recipient rule. Stock PR1051 measures the immediate and approximately 10 s sweeps after a real Slow, with the friendly pet excluded. The fixture fixes only sweep chance. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1051#issuecomment-7120753093

behavior-tests.source: The rank-zero 599 grant authors a two-second selected pet cast with 15 s own reuse, resource modifiers and the recurring sweep.
behavior-tests.runtime: The same owned pet must stay eligible through landing. The effect remains on that instance across parent Archive changes and ends on expiry or pet removal.
behavior-tests.test: ProxyMasterRecipientMode replays the retained stock setup. The focused tests cover resource clock, interval, expiry and scope. PR1003 verifies the exact cast and reuse interval and stock Archive behavior. PR1051 records the first stock request in the updated fixture, 190 IS, owned-only HP and sweep, and unaffected replacement. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1003#issuecomment-7108209660 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1051#issuecomment-7120753093

1107.note: PR1003 and PR1051 verify Proxy Master on the same owned pet. The historical absolute unmastered pet health-regeneration baseline remains unknown. The authored +50% bonus uses the common 1% maximum-health baseline and is verified at +0.5% max/s in the stock fixture. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1051#issuecomment-7120753093
